analysis.overall: A varied 24 hours marked by a double-peaked evening spike and a lingering overnight low, though your numbers settled into a much smoother routine by mid-morning.

events.title: Evening dinner spike
events.description: Glucose rose rapidly from the 70s up to a daily high of 218 mg/dL, prompting multiple boluses that pulled numbers down sharply within an hour.

events.title: Late-night rebound rise
events.description: Numbers rebounded back up above 200 mg/dL late in the evening. Frequent small correction doses eventually cleared the spike by midnight.

events.title: Extended overnight low
events.description: Glucose drifted down into the mid-50s overnight and stayed low for several hours despite automated basal suspensions before naturally rising at sunrise.

events.title: Breakfast bump & smooth return
events.description: A 25g carb breakfast caused a moderate rise peaking at 158 mg/dL, which gently returned back down to a baseline of 75 mg/dL by noon.

analysis.watch_for_tomorrow: Pay attention to late-evening fat or protein content that might cause slow-digesting rebound spikes and lead to overnight low drifts.
